images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a warm editorial watercolor and gouache illustration for an article about Dalkhai in western Odisha, India. Landscape 3:2. A small semicircle of adult women in modest Sambalpuri woven saris with restrained geometric borders, singing and making a gentle coordinated forward leaning dance gesture in an ordinary village courtyard; a seated barrel-drum musician at one edge, a few onlookers. Human, relaxed, unequal spacing, natural daytime light, ochre earth and muted greens, hand-painted paper texture. This is an imagined community dance scene, not a photograph or documentary reenactment of a particular ritual. Avoid classical Odissi costume or poses, Gujarati dandiya sticks, extravagant stage jewellery, text, logos and invented sacred iconography. Accurate human anatomy, no repeated faces, no glossy cinematic effects.

Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 warm editorial watercolor and gouache on textured paper for a Nuakhai article, western Odisha India. Intimate imagined household scene focused on a small leaf bowl of new-season rice beside golden rice panicles, with an older adult and younger adult sharing food at a low table, family members quietly nearby. Modest everyday woven cotton saris and shirts, subtle Sambalpuri geometric textile accents. Human proportions, natural expressions, ordinary courtyard veranda, soft daylight, muted earthy palette. Suggest the new harvest, care and reunion; do not depict a specific religious ceremony or claim a universally prescribed menu. Keep dishes simple and unidentified, no elaborate feast, no deity images, no text, no branding, no staged symmetry, no glowing magical light. Clearly hand-painted editorial illustration, not documentary photography.
